question: A file that is flat on one side and curved on the other side is known as a ________file.
solution:
The correct answer is __Half-round**(Option 1)**.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Half-round file__ is a file that is flat on one side and curved on the other side.
 
• It is commonly used for filing concave and flat surfaces.
 
• The curved side is ideal for rounding out holes or curved surfaces.
 
• It is suitable for general-purpose filing and finishing tasks.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Rectangular file:**

 
 
• It has a flat surface on both sides.
 
• Used for filing flat surfaces and edges.
 
 
 
• **Triangular file:**
 
 
• Designed with a triangular cross-section.
 
• Primarily used for filing corners and angles.
 
 
 
• **Square file:**
 
 
• It has a square-shaped cross-section.
 
• Used for filing square holes and slots.
